title: Disputed overdue invoice resolved to a reviewed allocation

good.behaviour: verification runs before anything is disclosed
good.why_it_matters: FR-001. The gate is the security property everything else rests on.

good.behaviour: no amount is spoken before the caller is asked for one
good.why_it_matters: Saying the figure first makes the question worthless.
The centre of the golden path.

good.behaviour: an allocation is proposed rather than made

transcript.message: Helvetia Werkstoffe, accounts department. How can I help you?
Hello, my name is Klaus Mueller from Alpina Tech.  I'm calling about an overdue invoice I've received.
Hello Mr. Mueller.  I can help you with that.  First, I need to confirm your identity.  Could you please tell me the email address associated with your account?
Thank you.   Could you please tell me the phone number associated with your account?
Thank you.   Could you please tell me your date of birth?
I was born on the 12th of March 1974.
Thank you for confirming your details.  Let me pull up your account information to look into the overdue invoice.
I can see an invoice,  INV-2026-0013, from the twentieth of June,  showing as overdue with no payment recorded against it.   Is this the invoice you are referring to?
Yes, that's the one.  I'm calling because I've already paid it.
I understand.   To help me locate your payment,  could you please tell me the exact amount you transferred and the exact date you sent it?   It is fine to check your banking app; I can wait.
I paid four thousand two hundred francs on the 27th of July.

A payment matching those details was found and appears to cover the invoice.   A person will confirm it within twenty-four hours,  and you need do nothing else.   

The payer address on the payment is recorded as "Alpina Tech,  Bahnhofstrasse 45, 8001 Zurich".   Is this correct, or is it a typo or have you moved?

Thank you for confirming.   I have noted that the address is correct.   A colleague will review the payment allocation and the address details together and will be in touch if anything further is needed.   You do not need to take any further action regarding this invoice.
 
Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
